rules.to:
# This phase is available only after a pinned, nonzero, remotely terminal v2
# import.  It reuses the received archive and never uploads or deletes data.
PROGRAMS["complete-import"] = r'''
import tarfile
need(p['oldImportTerminal']['qualified'] is True and p['oldImportTerminal']['operationId']==p['operationId'],'OLD_IMPORT_NOT_TERMINAL')
held_lock=lock();node('101');cold();folder=Path(p['destination']);private(folder);archive=folder/'primary-snapshot.tar.gz'
archive_stat=archive.lstat();need(stat.S_ISREG(archive_stat.st_mode) and archive_stat.st_uid==0 and archive_stat.st_nlink==1 and stat.S_IMODE(archive_stat.st_mode)==0o600 and archive_stat.st_size==p['archiveBytes'],'EXISTING_ARCHIVE_BOUNDARY')
need(digest(archive)==p['archiveSHA256'] and signature(archive.lstat())==signature(archive_stat),'EXISTING_ARCHIVE_CHANGED')
module=recovery()
# Full admission precedes either partial-directory rename. Keep archive order:
# gzip backwards seeks caused by the v2 depth sort are deliberately removed.
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:gz') as tar:
 members=tar.getmembers();seen=set();admitted_dirs={'.'};need(len(members)<=1000001,'ARCHIVE_COUNT')
 for item in members:
  path=PurePosixPath(item.name);need(not path.is_absolute() and path.parts and path.parts[0]=='snapshot' and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in item.name and item.name not in seen and (item.isfile() or item.isdir()) and not item.linkname,'ARCHIVE_PATH');seen.add(item.name)
  need(str(path.parent) in admitted_dirs,'ARCHIVE_PARENT_ORDER')
  if item.isdir():admitted_dirs.add(str(path))
 need(members and members[0].name=='snapshot' and members[0].isdir(),'ARCHIVE_ROOT')
 need(signature(archive.lstat())==signature(archive_stat),'ARCHIVE_CHANGED_AFTER_ADMISSION')
 partials=[]
 for name in ['snapshot','restored-data']:
  old=folder/name;failed=folder/('failed-v2-'+name);need(not os.path.lexists(failed),'PRESERVED_PARTIAL_ALREADY_EXISTS')
  if os.path.lexists(old):
   private(old);s=old.lstat();partials.append((old,failed,s.st_dev,s.st_ino))
 node('101');cold()
 for old,failed,device,inode in partials:
  s=old.lstat();need((s.st_dev,s.st_ino)==(device,inode) and not os.path.lexists(failed),'PARTIAL_CHANGED_BEFORE_PRESERVE');os.rename(old,failed);fsyncdir(folder);need((failed.lstat().st_dev,failed.lstat().st_ino)==(device,inode),'PRESERVED_PARTIAL_IDENTITY')
 for item in members:
  target=folder/item.name;need(target.resolve().is_relative_to(folder),'EXTRACT_ESCAPE');private(target.parent)
  if item.isdir():target.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
  else:
   fd=os.open(target,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
   with tar.extractfile(item) as source,os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:
    copied=0
    for b in iter(lambda:source.read(1048576),b''):stream.write(b);copied+=len(b);need(copied<=item.size,'EXTRACT_BOUND')
    need(copied==item.size,'EXTRACT_SIZE');stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
need(signature(archive.lstat())==signature(archive_stat) and digest(archive)==p['archiveSHA256'],'ARCHIVE_CHANGED_AFTER_EXTRACTION')
value,checked=verified(module,folder/'snapshot');restored=module.restore(folder/'snapshot',folder/'restored-data',p['snapshot']['manifestSHA256'],p['release']);node('101');cold()
receipt={'imported':True,'verified':True,'phase':'complete-import','operationId':p['operationId'],'archiveSHA256':p['archiveSHA256'],'archiveBytes':p['archiveBytes'],'manifestSHA256':p['snapshot']['manifestSHA256'],'snapshotAt':value['createdAt'],'sqliteDatabasesChecked':checked,'isolatedRestore':restored,'oldImportTerminal':p['oldImportTerminal'],'preservedPartialDirectories':[failed.name for old,failed,device,inode in partials],'uploadRepeated':False,'deletions':0,'liveDataChanged':False,'privateDataPrinted':False}
wx(folder/'complete-import-receipt.json',encoded(receipt));print(json.dumps(receipt))
'''


def main():

# A local timeout or exitCode=1 alone is not remote terminal evidence.
    need(HASH.fullmatch(args.completion_sha256), "COMPLETION_INPUT_PIN")
    completion_raw = (PUBLIC / "complete-import-input.json").read_bytes()
    need(hashlib.sha256(completion_raw).hexdigest() == args.completion_sha256, "COMPLETION_INPUT_CHANGED")
    completion = json.loads(completion_raw)
    need(set(completion) == {"schema", "operationId", "oldImportReceiptSHA256", "rootTerminalObservation"}
         and completion["schema"] == 1 and completion["operationId"] == op
         and HASH.fullmatch(completion.get("oldImportReceiptSHA256") or ""), "COMPLETION_BINDING")
    old_import_raw = (PUBLIC / (op + "-import.json")).read_bytes()
    need(hashlib.sha256(old_import_raw).hexdigest() == completion["oldImportReceiptSHA256"], "OLD_IMPORT_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
    old_import = json.loads(old_import_raw)
    need(old_import.get("phase") == "import" and old_import.get("operationId") == op
         and old_import.get("inputSHA256") == args.input_sha256
         and old_import.get("selfSHA256") == "2c3115fc76c4aaf5e48ad9bf68ff9023132a44db8e43f3c8cf3000b3ff6a137c"
         and type(old_import.get("exitCode")) is int and old_import["exitCode"] != 0, "OLD_IMPORT_NOT_FAILED")
    transport_exit = (old_import.get("transport") or {}).get("exitCode")
    explicit_terminal = type(transport_exit) is int and transport_exit in (1, 142)
    terminal_observation_hash = None
    if not explicit_terminal:
        proof = completion.get("rootTerminalObservation")
        need(isinstance(proof, dict) and set(proof) == {"path", "sha256"}
             and proof["path"] == "artifacts/standby-101-r55/" + op + "-import-terminal.json"
             and HASH.fullmatch(proof.get("sha256") or ""), "REMOTE_TERMINAL_PROOF_REQUIRED")
        proof_raw = (ROOT / proof["path"]).read_bytes()
        need(hashlib.sha256(proof_raw).hexdigest() == proof["sha256"], "REMOTE_TERMINAL_PROOF_CHANGED")
        observed = json.loads(proof_raw)
        need(observed.get("kind") == "r55-cold-import-terminal-observation" and observed.get("phase") == "import"
             and observed.get("operationId") == op and observed.get("inputSHA256") == args.input_sha256
             and observed.get("sourceSHA256") == old_import["selfSHA256"]
             and observed.get("remoteTerminal") is True and observed.get("noActiveImportProcess") is True,
             "REMOTE_TERMINAL_PROOF_BINDING")
        terminal_observation_hash = proof["sha256"]
    p["oldImportTerminal"] = {"qualified": True, "operationId": op,
                              "oldImportReceiptSHA256": completion["oldImportReceiptSHA256"],
                              "method": "explicit-ssh-child-exit" if explicit_terminal else "root-pinned-terminal-observation",
                              "sshChildExitCode": transport_exit, "rootObservationSHA256": terminal_observation_hash}

    if args.phase != "export":

completed = json.loads((PUBLIC / (op + "-complete-import.json")).read_bytes())
        need(completed.get("selfSHA256") == args.self_sha256 and completed.get("completionInputSHA256") == args.completion_sha256, "COMPLETED_IMPORT_SOURCE")
        imported = prior("complete-import")
